events.summary_en: President Volodymyr Zelensky discussed with Dutch Prime Minister Rob Jetten the strengthening of Ukraine’s air defense, particularly protection against Russian “Shahed” drones, as well as the prospects for trilateral talks between Ukraine, the U.S., and Russia.
